in_marathi.name: Krishnadas
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's grace, Krishna's servant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Krishnadas हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Krishnadas is derived from two Sanskrit words - Krishna (meaning dark, all-attractive, and divine) and dasa (meaning servant or slave). This name signifies being a devoted servant or devotee of Lord Krishna. It carries the blessings of the divine and the grace of the Almighty.
